items.summary: A new Seiko Year Watch Collection model marks the 2027 Year of the Sheep. Limited to 2,027 pieces, it has an off-white fleece-textured dial with a golden ram, a quartz movement, a 47 mm steel case and a price of 54,780 yen in Japan through I.E.I.

items.title: Casio delays £6,000 luxury G-Shock just before launch, with no new date confirmed
items.summary: Casio has postponed the Japanese release of its limited-edition G-Shock MR-G Haruka (MRG-B2100HR-1AJR), originally scheduled for 13 November 2026. The ¥1,100,000 anniversary watch features a handcrafted platinum-leaf dial and is limited to 800 pieces worldwide, but no replacement launch date has been announced.

items.title: Xbox Store lists new $2000 GTA 6 pre-order edition, with price causing sticker shock
